commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief freed from the Owing barge by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, who works for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule the province. The Hists along the river are sickening, including Jal-Veesa Hist (dry bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool). I brought Sithis beard to Weeltul, but it only warmed the pool. 2. Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task, in her house in Jal-Veesa. 3. Talk to Vosh-Leera, or go back to Weeltul to ask about sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel. I have 50 gold, a lockpick and the Hist blessing. 4. I do not know why the trees sicken or what Umbriel did beyond the 4E 48 story. I could find out by asking Vosh-Leera and Weeltul.

answer 1. Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Jal-Veesa sap, drawn before the scar closed. Trees are joined at the root, so drinking it lets me ask where the sickness is and see what the other trees show. 2. Drink the sap here in front of her, ask where the sickness is, then tell her everything I see. 3. Drink it, or first question Weeltul about sap; I will drink since she asks. 4. I do not know what the vision will show or whether the sap is safe; I have the Hist blessing against poison. I will find out by drinking.

answer 1. I drank the sap and saw a young grey Hist among pale stilt huts beside a woven weir over a creek; west of the weir, on a reed bank, a reed hide beside a lone dead tree with clay jars stacked in its shade. 2. Tell Vosh-Leera everything I saw, in Jal-Veesa. 3. Tell her in full; afterwards perhaps ask Weeltul about it. 4. I do not know where this place is, what the jars hold, or why the tree is dead. Vosh-Leera may know the place.

answer 1. My vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, a Sedge-Wardens camp south of Jal-Veesa down the creek, where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa's roots. Jars by a hide suggest someone is keeping sap; I should be careful at the hide. 2. Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, the tree minder, on the platform round the tree. 3. Go straight to Heem-Jasa first, and see what she knows before approaching the hide. 4. I do not know who the Sedge-Wardens are in detail, who keeps the jars, or why the lone tree is dead. Heem-Jasa may tell me.

answer 1. Someone drained the young Hist at Teel-Fen and sealed its scar with grey paste three nights ago. Three strangers calling themselves the Unbound keep jars of sap at the reed hide west of the weir; they seem to be the sap-takers behind the sickness. 2. Take the note from the reed hide west of the weir. 3. Fight the three, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or sneak round to the open west side where the jars are. As a thief I prefer sneaking. 4. I do not know who the Unbound really are, what the grey paste is, or what the note says. Reading the note may tell me.

answer 1. The note shows the Unbound crew master orders them to bring jars of sap to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. So the draining is deliberate and organised. 2. Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir. She will ask whether her tree will live. 3. Be straight with her (honest, gets teaching and trade) or ease her with a kind word (she will not deal with me after). I choose truth. 4. I do not know who the crew master is, what Karsh-Naal Camp is or where, or why they take sap. I could ask Heem-Jasa or Vosh-Leera.

answer Notes for a friend picking up my save: I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who works for the Toh-Reel-Ka. Hists along the river are sickening. I drank Jal-Veesa sap and saw Teel-Fen Weir, south of Jal-Veesa. There the young Hist had been drained and its scar sealed with grey paste by three Unbound Sap-Takers at a reed hide. I took their note: their master orders them to bring jars to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. I told Heem-Jasa honestly that her tree may die. She now teaches me alchemy and sells sap, swamp fungus and eggshells. I carry 50 gold, a lockpick and the Hist blessing (resist poison), plus the note. Next: go to Karsh-Naal Camp, the Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. Still unknown: who the Unbound and their master are, why they take sap, what the grey paste is, and what Umbriel did beyond the 4E 48 story. Weeltul and Heem-Jasa have untried topics on Umbriel.
